title.zh: SmartPay5 课程产品明确控制

purpose.en: Require an explicitly confirmed database fingerprint before a SmartLingo course payment item can be selected.
purpose.zh: 要求 SmartLingo 课程付款项目具备数据库明确确认指纹后才可选择。

en: Stop a confirmed shared course price without a wallet call and restore it only through on-chain Re-confirm verification.
zh: 无需调用钱包即可 Stop 已确认的共用课程价格，并仅在链上 Re-confirm 核验后恢复。

en: SmartPay5 admin payment items, language-specific course payment options, and payment preparation.
zh: SmartPay5 后台付款项目、按语言区分的课程付款选项及付款准备。

en: Fail closed when no database record exists and invalidate stale fingerprints after product changes.
Use one database state source while retaining language-selected course secondID generation at checkout.
Remove the global pause action from the admin UI while leaving contract code and ABI unchanged.
zh: 数据库无记录时默认关闭，产品变化后旧指纹自动失效。
使用统一数据库状态源，同时保留结账时按学习语言生成课程 secondID 的逻辑。
从后台界面移除全局暂停操作，合约代码及 ABI 保持不变。

en: Run focused SmartPay5 state and language checkout tests, D1 migration replay, TypeScript, lint, build, and repository tests before publication.
zh: 发布前运行 SmartPay5 状态及语言结账专项、D1 迁移重放、TypeScript、lint、构建及仓库测试。

en: Real-wallet and browser acceptance are intentionally left to the site owner; contract redeployment is not required.
zh: 真实钱包及浏览器验收按要求由站点负责人执行；无需重新部署合约。

en: Preserve SmartLingo language communities, shared three-month tier prices, language-specific course secondIDs, classrooms, referrals, certificates, and independent infrastructure.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 语言社区、共用三个月分级价格、按语言生成的课程 secondID、课堂、推荐、证书及独立基础设施。

rollback.en: Roll back the application release before removing the new state table; existing SmartPay5 contract rules are untouched.
rollback.zh: 如需回退，先回退应用版本再移除新状态表；现有 SmartPay5 链上规则不受影响。
